scope.intent: Brand visual-language package for a Pokemon 30th anniversary official-site style preview.
notFor: copying official Pokemon business content into unrelated projects

producer.notes: This is a reusable brand skin package. /qdmp may consume it later, but /brand owns the visual language contract.

--du-bg-2.evidence: Official main canvas computed style is background-color: rgb(254, 225, 42) (#fee12a); the earlier pale yellow preview layer was an internal misread, not the source-of-truth page background.
--du-bg-2.usage: Page shell and anniversary canvas background.

--du-bg-1.usage: Cards, list items, and readable content panels.

--du-text-1.evidence: Body color and list category fallback use #404248.

--du-text-2.evidence: Secondary copy needs a neutral readable layer between #404248 and the disabled gray scale; final computed verification required.

--du-text-3.evidence: CSS frequency extraction includes #b3bac7 in the site gray scale.

--du-border-1.evidence: CSS frequency extraction shows #dde1ea as a high-frequency border/light divider value.
--du-border-1.usage: Normal dividers and light card boundaries.

--du-primary-color.evidence: Computed action evidence bucket activeStateFill ranks #E5161A as the strongest selected/action red; use it as primary action token instead of category red.

--du-primary-border.evidence: Computed actionTextBorder evidence ranks #404248 as the dominant action text/border color; use it as the action edge/readability token.

--du-primary-soft-bg.evidence: Computed primaryActionFill evidence ranks #FFFB8A as the primary clickable fill family; keep it as the soft/light action surface.

--du-primary-solid-bg.evidence: Same computed action family as --du-primary-color via activeStateFill.

--du-secondary-color.evidence: Pokemon 30th yellow remains available as anniversary/logo accent after red is calibrated as primary action.

--style-font-body.evidence: HTML loads Google Font Noto Sans JP; CSS body font-family uses Noto Sans JP first.

--style-font-display.evidence: HTML loads Google Font Lato alongside Noto Sans JP.

--style-control-radius.evidence: Anniversary filter/buttons use pill-like interaction surfaces; exact per-selector computed verification still needed.
--style-control-radius.usage: Theme filter pills and small campaign controls.

--style-card-shadow.usage: Light floating card emphasis, not a heavy generic shadow.

--style-hero-ratio-pc.evidence: Hero PC image declares width 1920 and height 735.
--style-hero-ratio-pc.usage: Preserve official hero crop and do not force square card framing.

--style-hero-ratio-sp.evidence: Hero mobile source declares width 750 and height 642.

--style-category-palette.evidence: .anniv-30th-list__tag category modifiers define multiple semantic category colors.
--style-category-palette.usage: Category tags; do not collapse every category into --du-primary-color.

unsupported: exact official responsive art direction until screenshot/computed gate is added
exact official tab animation timing until computed/browser trace is added

slots.fallback: Use neutral light background only if official hero assets fail to load; do not replace with abstract gradients as final output.
Text brand label with Lato/Noto Sans JP.
Keep image box empty only with visible missing-asset state.
White card with anniversary logo text.

assets.usage: Desktop hero background for the 30th anniversary landing page.
assets.fit: preserve 1920x735 ratio; use picture art direction, not generic cover card crop
intrinsic image ratio; do not stretch

assets.usage: Current monthly theme badge, Pokemon x miru.
Decorative mascot/tab marker and section accent.
assets.fit: intrinsic SVG decoration; do not tile as full page background

assets.usage: Campaign banner for 1025 Pokemon 30th logo icons.

rules: Do not apply the RoCom torn-paper chain to this site; Pokemon 30th evidence is a picture hero plus white rounded feed cards.
Hero must consume picture sources and preserve official PC/SP ratios.
Category colors are semantic taxonomy colors and should remain per-category style-only values.
News card images use object-fit: contain and must not be cropped into decorative backgrounds.
Inspector hover tags must be absolutely positioned so they never push or resize hero/media content.

layers.coverage: HeroHeader background for desktop or wide preview.
Small decorative accent for filters or section header, not a tiled background.

imageFit.contentImage: .anniv-30th-list__img uses a ratio box and object-fit: contain; demo images should fill the card slot without stretching.
imageFit.heroImage: Use responsive picture sources; PC ratio 1920/735 and mobile ratio 750/642.

inspectorTag.positioning: absolute overlay outside normal document flow

h5.font: Use Google Font fallback stack when remote fonts are unavailable.
h5.image: Use <picture> or source-set equivalent when preview runtime supports it.

miniProgram.image: Use platform Image component with mode preserving aspect ratio; avoid CSS background for content-bearing news images.
miniProgram.navigation: Keep host mini-program navigation behavior; only skin colors, type and assets.

qdmp.relationship: Consumes Brand MOD as visual-language input only; /qdmp remains responsible for mini-program feature scaffolding and business pages.

gates.reason: HTML captured and contains official navigation, hero picture sources, theme badge, filter tabs and banner evidence.
CSS captured and sampled for font stack, high-frequency colors, card radius, shadow and category palette.
This turn creates the MOD input first; demo shell rendering should consume this package next.
User requested a new example for learning; no business project apply is performed.

ruleCandidates.abstractMechanism: Campaign sites often expose the most important visual language through a responsive picture hero, official logo image, theme badge and card/list feed rather than a full section-background chain.
ruleCandidates.appliesWhen: Source HTML contains a hero picture/source set plus campaign theme/filter/news modules.
evidenceRequired: Hero picture or computed background image with intrinsic dimensions.
Source navigation or feed structure proving the page is a campaign/anniversary landing page.
Card/list CSS showing surface, image fit and tag/category treatment.
ruleCandidates.scriptCheck: extract hero picture sources, image dimensions, category filters and card image object-fit before generating preview.

promotion.next: Test against one non-game anniversary/campaign site before making it a blocking rule.

ruleCandidates.abstractMechanism: Category colors can encode taxonomy rather than brand primary color; they should become style-only semantic palette entries instead of being collapsed into one primary token.
ruleCandidates.appliesWhen: CSS contains repeated category-specific selectors such as tag--game, tag--app, tag--goods or equivalent taxonomy classes.
evidenceRequired: At least three category-specific color selectors.
DOM or text labels proving those colors represent content categories.
A replacement plan that preserves category distinguishability.
ruleCandidates.scriptCheck: scan CSS selectors for category/status/tag modifiers and report candidate semantic palettes separately from mapped --du-primary-color.

promotion.next: Compare with RoCom activity/status/category tags and one commerce/news site.
